title: The demotion gate: how a live strategy goes back to paper

triggers.trigger: week-cluster 90% lower bound on benchmark-relative Brier skill below 0 over any rolling 4-week window
pre-registered sample floor breached (n < 100 graded games)
input drift alarm fails on two consecutive runs
a price claim is later found not to meet policy C1-C4

effect: status moves live -> paper; the history is kept; the event is dated and reasoned; promotion back to live requires the promote trigger in mind.json

state.reason_none_can_yet_be_live: no strategy has a claimable price, so none can be staked; the gate is published before it is needed rather than added after a loss
